# AIR-pixel Liquid Glass
A configurable Liquid Glass theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It adds translucent interface surface
s, an optional wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-
side conversation contrast controls.

## Features

- Frosted surfaces with adjustable strength, blur, tint, and wallpaper.
- Optional transparent deskt
op and Windows window material controls. Desktop transparency requires the included client patch hel

per; the setting reports when the patch is unavailable.
- Custom cursors and click ripples, each ind

ependently configurable.
- Separate contrast settings for human and assistant messages.
- English an
d Chinese settings UI.
## Install
Install `air-pixel-liquid-glass` as a DeepSeek Harness bundle, then enable **Liquid Glass** in Setti
ngs. The desktop transparency and window blur controls need their host-side patch; the theme and oth
er visual options do not.
## Development
Requires Node.js. Run the syntax and behavior checks with:

`compat` answers "why did the theme disappear after an update" against the installed Harness: the ma
nifest gate, the client slot contract, and the host patch.
Regenerate the images above with `node tools/docshots.mjs` (writes `assets/`, which `screenshots.jso
n` points the plugin market at). Some visual inspection scripts need Python with Pillow. See DEVELOP
MENT.md for architecture, checks, and rename migration details.
## Compatibility
Designed for DeepSeek Harness on Windows and the web GUI. Desktop transparency and window blur depen
d on the installed Harness build and supported Windows compositor APIs.
**The manifest deliberately declares no `engines.dsh` and no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range.** That
is not an oversight. `dsh-app-boot` compares those ranges against the running runtime and **throws*
* when they do not match, which takes the whole plugin off the boot path — and no semver range can c
over the next prerelease. A range pinned to `0.2.1-rc.2` fails on `0.2.1-rc.5`; a caret range that s
urvives `0.2.1-rc.5` still fails on `0.2.2-rc.1`, because semver only admits prereleases of the exac
t `major.minor.patch` tuple a comparator names. On a nightly channel that means every update is a fr
nor.patch` tuple a comparator names. On a nightly channel that means every update is a fresh outage.
So compatibility is checked at run time instead of declared up front:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It reports the running core version, whether the manifest would be gated, whether the client contrac
t the theme depends on (`settings.section` + `slots.register`) still exists in the installed package
s, and whether the host patch is still in place. Anything the check cannot confirm is a warning the
settings panel also shows, rather than a silent disappearance.
The slots seat moved into the core's client runner in the `0.2.x` line, so `0.1.x` cores are out — s
tay on plugin `0.1.0` there.
## Permissions and behavior
The plugin injects theme styles and custom cursors into the Harness web UI, reads and writes its own
JSON settings through a local host API, and logs diagnostic status through the host logger. The opt
ional `tools/asarpatch.py` helper modifies the installed client's main-process file — `lib/main.js`,
inside `app.asar` when the archive is sealed, or in place under `resources/app/` when the archive h
as been unpacked — and only when run explicitly by the user; it keeps a backup and supports checking
or reverting the patch. The patch is lost on every client update and has to be re-applied. The plug
in does not make external network requests.
